omitted: A full-year 2026 revenue range of $3.0–3.2 billion is sometimes attributed to the November 12, 2026 earnings call. The furnished shareholder letter and earnings release say the company expects the low end of the existing $3.0–3.4 billion range. No earnings-call transcript was furnished on EDGAR through November 24, 2026, so a $3.0–3.2 billion call figure is not given a row.

A 2025 capex raise to about $5 billion, and a FY 2025 revenue range of $500–550 million, are widely attributed to the November 11, 2025 earnings call. They were not in the shareholder letter or earnings release extracted for this version.
The server-and-network share of capex is not disclosed. The model uses 85% as an estimate and shows 70% and 100% beside it.
GPU-count deployment targets beyond the Finland 'up to 60,000 H100-equivalent' capacity statement were not found as dated guidance with a later actual.

revisions.label: Still shown as $7–9 billion

revisions.note: The letter says full-year 2026 guidance was reaffirmed across all metrics. It does not restate the ARR range in that sentence.

revisions.label: December target replaced
revisions.note: The company said it had guided to $7–9 billion by December and now expects ARR to exceed $7 billion for the month of February, a shift of about two months. From 2027 it will guide revenue, pre-tax earnings, and capacity instead of ARR.

actual.note: Latest reported ARR, which is before the revised February 2027 timing. Not a December actual.

revisions.label: Exceed $7 billion in February
revisions.note: Replaces the December 2026 arrival. The company said this is expected even before New Jersey ramps to full capacity.

actual.note: Last reported ARR. The target month has not arrived.

revisions.label: $3.0–3.4 billion
revisions.note: Shown as 2026 revenue guidance on the Q1 2026 highlights page, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of about 40%.

revisions.label: Reaffirmed
revisions.note: Full-year 2026 guidance reaffirmed across all metrics.

revisions.label: Low end of the $3.0–3.4 billion range
revisions.note: The furnished November 12, 2026 letter says some third-party capacity moved into the first half of 2027 and the company now expects revenue at the low end of the existing $3.0–3.4 billion range. The top of the range was not withdrawn. A narrower $3.0–3.2 billion range was not in the furnished letter or release. No call transcript was furnished on EDGAR through November 24, 2026. The independently published earnings-call transcript reports a narrowed $3.0–3.2 billion range; see the November 12 call transcript in the source catalog. This row preserves the filed letter wording rather than silently conflating the two.

actual.note: Nine-month revenue, not a full-year actual. Q1 399.0 + Q2 582.3 + Q3 980.8.
